votes.quote: on motion by normandin and second by jewell, minutes were approved. all in favor.

votes.motion: Approve the requested offset variances for 42 Pearl Street (leach field, septic tank, sewer line, property line).
votes.quote: on motion by normandin and second by jewell, the board unanimously approved the requested variances.

votes.motion: Approve the septic variance for a garage at 284 Lancaster Avenue (6.5 foot offset).
votes.quote: on motion by fortin and second by normandin, the board voted to approve the variance.

votes.motion: Approve the groundwater offset variance for 30 West Street Terrace (4 feet to 2 feet).
votes.quote: on motion by normandin and second by fortin, the variance was approved.

votes.motion: Approve the wetland and groundwater offset variances for 441 Townsend Harbor Road, with a 2 bedroom deed restriction.
votes.quote: on motion by jewell and second by normandin, the variances were approved with the need for a 2 bedroom deed restriction.
on motion by normandin and seconded by watters, the meeting was adjourned at 9:05 pm, all in favor.

decisions.decision: Board rejected the 35 Pleasantview request without prejudice and advised the applicant he may resubmit with the allowable number of rooms or a septic expansion.
decisions.quote: the board rejected the request without prejudice and advised mr. brogna that he could resubmit his request with either the allowable number of rooms or an expansion of the septic system.

decisions.decision: Letter sent to the developer at 360 Flat Hill requiring soil testing for contaminants including arsenic; mitigation required if contaminants are found.
decisions.quote: a letter was sent to the developer stating that soil testing would be required to determine if there are any contaminants including arsenic.

decisions.decision: Agent Garreffi to report back to the board after inspecting the 5 Wallis Park repairs.
decisions.quote: mr. garreffi will report back after inspection.

decisions.decision: 71 Wildwood addition: a revised plan to be submitted for review, with a reduction in room count, in keeping with the discussion.
decisions.quote: a revised plan will be submitted for review in keeping with this discussion and a reduction in room count.
